remarks: WOW! Two 100% updated apartments in a building that has been completely renovated (electric, plumbing, heating/cooling, ducts, insulation, siding, finishes). The first floor unit has an eat-in kitchen, living room, bedroom and full bath with shower/tub. The second floor unit has an eat-in kitchen, two bedrooms, and a full bath (shower). Both units have appliances that are near new (refrigerator, gas range w/ hood, d/w, stackable w/d). Great units for excellent rental income. Separate gas and electric meters for each unit and for common elements. Pleasant yard and lots of on-site parking. Walkable residential neighborhood with nice yards, drives and garages, a mix of one and two family homes. Incredibly convenient to shopping, healthcare, and transportation (bus currently stops nearby). Rents currently being received are great -- tenants interested in remaining.

facts.laundryLoc: Each unit has a washer and dryer.
